notes.title: We’ve put together a small video showcasing the current state of our new level
notes.notes:
We’ve put together a small video showcasing the current state of our new level – The Treasure Vault! 💰⚔️

[previewyoutube=Qnc10HvYwoA;full][/previewyoutube]

Overlord and Lyria infiltrate the vault, but the guards have a plan: if they can’t win, they’ll destroy the door mechanism! Every move matters in this tactical fight.
Check out the video and let us know what you think! 👀

notes.title: We’ve added spell scrolls that can be used during a level! 📜✨
notes.notes:
The first one is the Spell Cooldown Reset Scroll. 

[previewyoutube=qMx2ggC-Zww;full][/previewyoutube]
Need to reset a spell’s cooldown instantly? Just use this scroll!
In the video, Overlord casts "Undead Touch", dealing massive damage. Then, he uses a Cooldown Reset Scroll and casts it again on the Guard. 
The guard dies, and a skeleton rises in his place. Powerful! 💀⚡

notes.title: Another update – we’ve added an Action Points (AP) Restoration Potion! 🔥
notes.notes:
In the video, Succubus Lyria moves toward an enemy, losing AP, then drinks a restoration flask and gains +1 AP. 

[previewyoutube=GNp8vuISs1o;full][/previewyoutube]
This gives her the advantage to cast Hypnosis on the guard! 🌀
The potion comes in three levels—the higher the level, the more AP it restores.
You can buy it for gold from 🧙‍♂️ Alchemist Vemund. Plan ahead before battle! ⚔️

notes.title: We've added new potion flasks to the game! 🎉
notes.notes:
Today, we’ve completed the development of the Health Restoration Potion. 

[previewyoutube=Hnnkl7j3lXM;full][/previewyoutube]
In the video, you can see the Overlord taking -2 HP damage, then drinking a red potion and restoring +1 HP. 🧪
Potions come in three levels—the higher the level, the stronger the effect! 💪
You can get these potions from 🧙‍♂️ Alchemist Vemund in the Laboratory between levels. Be sure to stock up before battle! ⚔️

notes.title: New spell in Chronicles of Overlord: "Teleport"!
notes.notes:
Last up is the spell "Teleport". 

[previewyoutube=Jg5_ywqlRk0;full][/previewyoutube]

This spell is cast by the lovely Succubus Lyria. With Teleport, she can move any character to any point on the battlefield. Imagine this: first, we cast Magical Shield on the Overlord to boost his health, then we teleport him straight behind enemy lines! Now, that’s a strategy! 😈✨

notes.title: New spell in Chronicles of Overlord: "Magical Shield"!
notes.notes:
Next spell is "Magical Shield". 

[previewyoutube=8Nhsq2HSsVY;full][/previewyoutube]

This spell is cast by the Succubus and can be applied to any unit on the battlefield. The higher the skill level, the stronger the shield. The hero receiving the shield gets extra health points, which can be crucial in a tough battle against enemy units. ⚡🛡️

notes.title: New spell in The Chronicles of Overlord: "Summon Undead"!
notes.notes:
Next up is the spell "Summon Undead". 

[previewyoutube=yYpGftnh1wc;full][/previewyoutube]

Depending on its upgrade level, the Overlord can summon different types of skeletons to aid in battle. At base level, a simple Skeleton with a melee sword attack. At level 2, the Dark Knight appears — still a melee fighter but much stronger! At level 3, a powerful Lich Mage is summoned, who uses ranged spells to attack. ⚔️💀

notes.title: New spell in Chronicles of Overlord: "Absorption"!
notes.notes:
We’re working on a series of short videos showcasing the progress for the next update of The Chronicles of Overlord demo.

[previewyoutube=vIYqvKBAy1k;full][/previewyoutube]

First up is the spell "Absorption". It drains Action Points (AP) from all enemy units in its area of effect. This means your opponents will have fewer moves next turn, while the Overlord gains extra AP to dominate the battlefield. Like, smashing everyone to bits. Cool, right? 😎

notes.title: Magical Essences and Gold — Even More Power at Your Fingertips! 💰✨
notes.notes:
In The Chronicles of Overlord, you’ll manage not just your heroes but also your resources! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/cb7cd61b4f0dd0a662e8bdd001dc650122258a24.png[/img]

🌀 Magical Essences
Earned by successfully completing levels, these are essential for upgrading and unlocking new skills for your favorite heroes. Collect enough essences to power up your team and take them to the next level!

💰 Gold
Gold is rewarded for completing various missions. It opens up exciting opportunities: health and movement boosts, unique artifacts, and powerful scrolls that can help you tackle the toughest challenges on any level. 🧙‍♂️

Which currency will be your favorite? The choice is yours! Meanwhile, we’re hard at work on version 0.0.2, set to release this March! Stay tuned! 🎮

notes.title: 🔥 Introducing the prototype of our next level — the Treasure Vault!
notes.notes:
🔥 Introducing the prototype of our next level — the Treasure Vault!

⚔️ This is the third level in the "Overlord vs. Humans" campaign.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/fd7e70b4b805051da76a0ae043f4055d07603cee.jpg[/img]

What’s exciting about it:
👉 There’s a mechanism that locks the door to the treasure room—something the Overlord really needs to get into.
👉 Once the humans figure this out, they’ll try to destroy the mechanism…and you along with it.

Level objective:
👉 Defend the mechanism, destroy all enemies, and claim those awesome artifacts and piles of gold!

A bit of backstory:
👉 The Overlord has decided to seize the Spheres by force—nothing comes easy in this life.
Vemund, the Alchemist, tells the Overlord about the artifacts and gold hidden in the humans’ treasure vault. Intrigued, the Overlord decides to strengthen his position by raiding their treasure.

What do you think of the new level? Share your thoughts below! 🛡️✨

notes.title: 🔥Update time: We’ve made some tweaks to the interface for the next release!
notes.notes:
🔥Update time: We’ve made some tweaks to the interface for the next release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/1fc71c8d6476e2e7c5a00173f6a13d45b71be373.jpg[/img]
👉Removed the hero icons on the left—they weren’t being used much and just took up space.
👉Moved the objectives panel to the left side.
👉Added a border around the screen inspired by classic fantasy games.
👉Introduced action point counters on the battlefield. Based on playtest feedback, we realized players needed a clearer way to calculate AP (action points). Now, when you hover over a tile within your movement range, a gray circle shows the AP cost to reach it.
👉Added AP tooltips to spells and basic attacks in the selection panel. This makes tactical planning easier. 
👉Added a border around the screen inspired by classic fantasy games. If you don’t have enough AP for a spell or attack, the gray circle won’t appear.

notes.title: Skill Tree Development Almost Finished for The Chronicles of Overlord! 🎮🛡️
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=CRO2Jv82wzQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Phew—this was a challenging one! We’re putting the final touches on the skill tree and hope to release it in update 0.0.2.

Each hero (Overlord, Succubus, and Wemun) will have three unique abilities, each with three upgrade levels 🔮.

🌶 Abilities can be leveled up, but keep in mind that skill points won’t be enough to max out every skill. This allows you to create unique combinations of spells and abilities for your favorite characters. We're aiming for the perfect balance of challenge, fun, and playability ⚔️.

👉 What kind of skills and abilities would you like to see? Share your ideas!

notes.title: Immersion in The Chronicles of Overlord
notes.notes:
Dive into our world by mastering the game's fundamental mechanics! Here’s what you need to know:

[previewyoutube=p4KazcRFzkI;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*]Grid Movement: Explore the battlefield by moving across tiles to find optimal positions for attack or cover.
[*]Basic Attacks: Each character has a “regular attack,” such as a sword strike or a bow shot.
[*]Spells and Unique Attacks: Unlock powerful spells and special attacks to turn the tide of battle in your favor.
[*]Action Points: Plan your moves carefully! Action points determine how many actions you can take in a single turn, whether it’s moving, attacking, or casting spells.
[/list]
These elements form the foundation of The Chronicles of Overlord and all turn-based tactical games. Get ready for strategic decisions and thrilling combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/fac864e15c297779c62a3339a6a573b15c255dfe.png[/img]

What awaits you in these beautiful forests? Dangerous beasts? Enemies? Perhaps hostile Elves? Be prepared for anything as you explore the perilous world of [b]The Chronicles of Overlord[/b].

notes.title: Succubus Lyria: Beauty and Wisdom
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/c5a8ea8f506c02f8e51245ff8eb863b8843b5eb9.png[/img]

Lyria grew up in the Realm of Flowing Waterfalls, where succubi lived peacefully under the rule of a royal dynasty. After her mother’s death, the king took Lyria into his family. She became a royal advisor, helping the kingdom thrive, though she always felt a deep sense of loneliness.

Everything changed when the Overlord appeared. He was courageous, wise, and strong—everything she had been searching for. Falling in love with him, Lyria vowed eternal loyalty and joined him on his journey to conquer other worlds.

[b]Why do you think succubi are often portrayed as both beautiful and intelligent?[/b]

notes.title: Overlord and the Spheres: The Last Chance to Save the World
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/f1944000d443a8682afb22e309561483c0761d44.png[/img]

The only way to stop the Devourer and save the world is to unite all the Spheres of Omnipresence. Their combined power is the final barrier preventing Azatar's arrival in this realm.

The Overlord, understanding the gravity of the threat, offers humans his Sphere of Death, hoping to forge an alliance with the other races. But the humans see only evil in him, refusing to cooperate or make concessions.

Now, the Overlord has no other choice. To save the world, he must seize the Spheres through cunning and force. The time for negotiation is over—only action will decide the fate of this world.

[b]Would you keep searching for compromise, or would you choose to act by force when the fate of the world is at stake?[/b]

notes.title: The Beginning of a Grand Game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/598912e92bee993ca8b4e323d51b7e63bb67464b.png[/img]

Immerse yourself in a medieval world of swords and sorcery, inhabited by various races: humans, elves, orcs, undead, and many more. In this realm, four powerful artifacts—The Spheres of Omnipresence—shape the destiny of every being.

Each race wields a sphere that grants them incredible powers:

[list]
[*]Humans possess the Sphere of Creation, advancing magic and science to ensure the prosperity of their society.
[*]Elves guard the Sphere of Life, crafting miraculous potions and elixirs that grant healing and strength.
[*]Orcs command the Sphere of Destruction, harnessing fire and empowering their warriors with unmatched might.
[*]Necropolis controls the Sphere of Death, summoning souls and transforming them into undead to maintain the balance between life and death.
[/list]

But dark forces stir in the shadows: The Renegades, traitors to their people, seek to claim all the spheres and unleash the destructive power of the Devourer upon the world.

[b]Will you be able to stop this threat and protect your world? The grand game is just beginning.[/b]

notes.title: Saving the World: The Overlord's Mission
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/db49fb276e6ea52d7bcaa68880d1d71be2edcad9.png[/img]

An inevitable threat looms over the world: The Devourer seeks to invade and destroy it.

Aware of the danger, the Overlord offers his Sphere of Death in exchange for help in uniting all the spheres of power. He hopes his proposal will foster cooperation among the races to save the world. However, his offer is rejected, as humans view his intentions with suspicion, unwilling to compromise or negotiate with other races.

Realizing that time is running out and the world can't afford to wait, the Overlord decides to take matters into his own hands. He takes responsibility for saving the world, gathering the spheres through force and cunning, preparing for the final battle against the Devourer.

Your mission is to help the Overlord in this perilous and complex task—unite the powers, overcome obstacles, and stop the impending catastrophe.

[b]Would you continue negotiating, or would you prefer to take everything by force?[/b]

notes.title: Necropolis: The Awakening of the Ancient City of the Undead
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/4fe0211dc19e16b5e05964e86890fe5b3e6d9343.png[/img]

Necropolis is a mysterious fortress of the undead, shrouded in eternal twilight and surrounded by dark legends. Long ago, brave adventurers ventured there, but only one returned—driven mad, with a warning: the city awaits its Overlord, and any uninvited guests are doomed to a terrifying fate.

Two centuries ago, the old Overlord left, leaving the city isolated from the world. Now, the new Overlord returns, ready to remind the world of Necropolis. The city is home to a host of undead creatures: zombies, skeletons, death knights, and other otherworldly beings.

[b]Have you ever been to a mysterious place like the Necropolis?[/b]

notes.title: The Overlord's Journey: Worlds Beyond and the Battle with the Dragon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/2be3fe67ebd8018bfc15a7709ac0a8ec44ef8b4a.png[/img]

After becoming the Overlord of Death, he embarked on a journey through countless realms, encountering incredible creatures and embarking on dangerous adventures. Along the way, he met Lyria, a succubus who became his loyal companion.

However, their path crossed with the Dragon of the In-Between, a powerful foe who attacked them. The Overlord defeated the dragon but drained all his magical powers in the process.

Now, he must restore his strength, returning to his home world with Lyria by his side. The time to recover requires rest, and his homeland is where he can regain his powers most swiftly.

[b]If you could travel between worlds, what would you seek—adventure, power, or peace?[/b]

notes.title: The Overlord's Rise: From Warrior to Keeper of the Sphere of Death
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/74e3abe7495541e131a4daa304e4916d239915e5.png[/img]
Centuries ago, the Overlord was once a mere human—a brave warrior and protector of his kingdom. He lost everything: his family, home, and friends, when a treacherous aristocracy overthrew the king and slaughtered the royal family. Betrayed and branded a criminal, the Overlord was forced to fight for survival.

In his final battle, he fell to his enemies, but his relentless thirst for vengeance opened a new path. Offered the chance to become the Keeper of the Sphere of Death, he accepted. Now transformed into the powerful Overlord of Death, he has altered his very being, roaming between worlds in pursuit of justice against the traitors.

[b]Do you believe revenge can be a worthy goal, even if it means sacrificing your humanity?[/b]
